name: Alesis Nitro Max (nephew's kit)
source: Photos of the kit (2026-11-13, not stored in the repo) + Alesis Nitro Max user guide section 5.2

coordinateSystem.note: Same as src/kit/types.ts. Right-handed kit as seen from the drummer's seat. x: 0 = drummer's left .. 1 = right. y: 0 = far/back .. 1 = near the drummer. size = piece diameter relative to stage HEIGHT. Stage aspect is 16:9.
coordinateSystem.derivedFrom: the top-down photo (640x482 px). x = (px + 108.5) / 857, y = py / 482. Perspective makes cymbals look larger than real; sizes below use real proportions (10in = 0.24, 8in = 0.192).

confidence: Positions are approximate (about +/- 0.03). Kick and hi-hat pedal are estimated from the front photo because the top-down photo cuts off the foot area. The user can fine-tune everything in the kit editor.

pieces.physical: 10in single-zone pad on stand + foot controller
10in single-zone pad with choke, back centre-left above tom 1
10in dual-zone mesh, front left of centre
8in single-zone mesh, front right (floor tom position)
kick tower + beater pedal, right foot, centre-right in front

nonPlayable.note: Nitro Max module on the rack, between hi-hat and tom 1
Hi-hat foot controller, left foot, in front of the snare's left side. Its MIDI note 44 is a zone of the hihat piece, not a separate piece.

defaultMidiNotes.source: Alesis Nitro Max user guide, section 5.2 (parsed from PDF text, verify with MIDI learn)

differencesFromCurrentAppDefaults.crash2: app default kit has crash2; the real kit has only one crash
differencesFromCurrentAppDefaults.rideBell: app has ride bell note 53; the ride pad is single-zone, so no bell
differencesFromCurrentAppDefaults.positions: app defaults were guesses; use the positions above
differencesFromCurrentAppDefaults.hihatExtras: add halfOpen 23 and splash 21 to the hihat zones

hardware.usb: USB-B (square) port on the rear of the module, unconnected in the photo; power adapter 9 V DC plugged in
hardware.audioOut: L/MONO output has a cable plugged in; AUX IN present
hardware.bluetooth: Logo on the front. Per the user guide it is an audio profile (A2DP), not Bluetooth MIDI. Use USB for MIDI.
